result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: The summons requirements apply unless another statute requires otherwise.
claims.quote: (a) Except as otherwise required by statute, a summons shall be directed to the defendant, signed by the clerk and issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending, and it shall contain:
claims.note: The exception qualifies the required contents.

claims.claim: The summons must direct the defendant to file a written response with the court.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint
claims.note: The statute calls the response a written pleading.

claims.claim: The stated filing deadline is 30 days after service of the summons on the defendant.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: The summons must warn that, absent that response, default will be entered upon the plaintiff’s application.
claims.quote: (4) A notice that, unless the defendant so responds, their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff
claims.note: The draft retains the application condition.

claims.claim: The warning must say the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint.
claims.quote: and the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint

claims.claim: Wage garnishment is a possible result.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages

claims.claim: Money or property could be taken, or other relief could result.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.

claims.claim: The cited form is Judicial Council form SUM-100, revised July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons), Rev. July 1, 2009

claims.claim: SUM-100 specifies 30 calendar days after service of the summons and legal papers.
claims.quote: You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you

claims.claim: SUM-100 directs the defendant to file a written response at the court.
claims.quote: to file a written response at this court

claims.claim: SUM-100 also directs the defendant to have a copy served on the plaintiff within that period.
claims.quote:
You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you to file a written response at this court and have a copy
served on the plaintiff.

claims.claim: SUM-100 warns that a letter or phone call will not protect the defendant.
claims.quote: A letter or phone call will not protect you.

result.summary: The current statute and SUM-100 support each claim within the stated scope. The draft distinguishes entry of default upon application from the relief that may follow.
